area_note: Kuala Lumpur and the wider Klang Valley: Petaling Jaya, Subang Jaya, Bukit Jalil, Mont Kiara/Sri Hartamas, TTDI, and Putrajaya/Cyberjaya. Hash chapters meet at trail sites up to an hour outside the city.
intro: Because of the heat, most Klang Valley club runs happen after dark on weeknights, usually starting between 7:30pm and 9pm, or at dawn at weekends. The regular meeting points are KLCC Park, Sri Hartamas, TTDI, Desa ParkCity, Bukit Jalil and Dataran PHB Saujana, and Bukit Kiara has forest trails close to the city. Nearly all clubs are free to join and post each week's sessions on Instagram or in a WhatsApp group, so check there before your first run.

clubs.name: BJS Run Club

meets.when: Mondays 8:30pm (workouts such as tempo runs, hill repeats, fartleks and intervals)
meets.where: Bukit Jalil National Stadium, Keris / Astro North Visitor Entrance

meets.when: Wednesdays 8:30pm (faster speed sessions, reported by Star Publications in Jul 2026; the club's Instagram bio lists only Mondays)
meets.where: Bukit Jalil National Stadium

clubs.who: All levels on Mondays, with pace groups from about 4:30 to 7:30 min/km, each with pacers; Wednesdays are aimed at faster runners
clubs.description: A large weeknight crew at Bukit Jalil. Bibz Eats reported more than 100 runners at Monday sessions, and sponsors often bring shoe trials and lucky draws. Sessions are called off when the air quality index is above 120, and runners bring their own water.
clubs.active_evidence: Instagram post for the Monday tempo session, 26 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Windrunners

meets.where: Plaza Arkadia, Desa ParkCity

meets.when: Weekend long runs, announced close to the day (Star Publications reported a 5:30am gather and about 6:10am start in Jul 2026)
meets.where: Usually Dataran PHB Saujana, Subang; sometimes Padang Merbok

clubs.who: Pace groups from about 4:30 to 7:30 min/km
clubs.description: A weeknight workout and weekend long-run crew whose shoe-brand partners often host try-on runs at Plaza Arkadia. The weekend long runs suit anyone building up to a half or full marathon.
clubs.active_evidence: XTEP shoe try-on run at Plaza Arkadia, 28 Oct 2026 (Instagram)

clubs.name: Weekends Athletics

meets.where: Sources differ: Sri Hartamas Park (Bibz Eats, Mar 2026) or Persiaran LHDN / Plaza Arkadia, Desa ParkCity (Star Publications, Jul 2026); check the schedule highlight on Instagram

clubs.who: Open to everyone; social pace of about 6:00 to 7:00 min/km
clubs.description: A KL running and fitness community with a relaxed social run on Tuesday evenings. Despite the name, the regular session is midweek; it also holds weekend runs and brand events, such as a shake-out run before the 2026 KL Standard Chartered Marathon.
clubs.active_evidence: Pre-KLSCM shake-out run with adidas, 3 Oct 2026 (Instagram)

clubs.name: ASICS Running Club Malaysia (ARC)

meets.where: Institut Sukan Negara, Bukit Jalil (per the club's Instagram bio); other venues such as UM Arena are sometimes used, so check each week's poster

clubs.cost: Free, but you must register in advance through the QR code on each week's poster
clubs.who: Open to all, but the structured sessions suit more serious runners; places are limited
clubs.description: A brand-run club with structured speed sessions, including track intervals, split into pace groups. Bibz Eats reported that sessions are capped at the first 200 people to register.

clubs.name: Puma Nitro Run Club Malaysia

meets.where: TAR UMT Arena, Setapak

clubs.description: Puma's Malaysian run club, led by a head coach and a strength coach. Each month's programme mixes recovery runs, strength work, threshold sessions and track repeats, with occasional Puma shoe trials.

clubs.name: KJ Run Club (Kelana Jaya Run Club)

meets.when: Several sessions a week, published in a monthly schedule on Instagram
meets.where: Mainly Kelana Jaya, Stadium MBPJ (Petaling Jaya) and Dataran PHB Saujana; venues change

clubs.who: SAYS describes it as open to walkers, beginners and experienced runners; Bibz Eats found the sessions fast and suited to runners with some experience
clubs.description: A Petaling Jaya club founded in December 2019 and now a registered society. It mixes running sessions with some strength work and occasional trail runs, at several locations around PJ and KL.

clubs.name: Journey Run Club

meets.where: Sri Hartamas Park

clubs.description: An easy-paced Monday night social run in Sri Hartamas where you can just turn up. It's a night run on shared paths, so bring a light or reflective gear. In early November 2026 its Instagram bio said the community run was paused during the haze, so check before going.
clubs.active_evidence: Crew team at the adidas Hyperrelay, Instagram post 15 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Brand New Waves Running Club (BNWRC)

meets.when: Midweek easy 5 km at 8:30pm; the day is posted each week (Wednesday 4 Nov 2026)
meets.where: TTDI; the Senior Golfers' Association for the 4 Nov 2026 run
Varies; KLCC Park and partner venues

clubs.who: All abilities; social pace of about 6:30 to 7:30 min/km over about 5 km
clubs.description: Five friends started this lifestyle-oriented crew in 2019. Its partners have included New Balance, Puma, Zus Coffee and Oatside, and runners often stay on to socialise afterwards. Venues are confirmed each week on Instagram and in its WhatsApp community.
clubs.active_evidence: Midweek 5 km announced for 4 Nov 2026; Sunday 5 km with Puma, 1 Nov 2026 (Instagram)

clubs.name: Godspeed Running Club

meets.where: Bukit Kiara Youth Centre area; meeting point rotates

clubs.who: Join by referral from a member, by attending one of its events, or by sending a DM
clubs.description: A crew founded in 2020 whose sessions rotate between intervals, hill sprints, trail runs and urban routes. Its motto puts progress ahead of finishing times.
clubs.active_evidence: Indoor session at The Project, Instagram post 22 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Kyserun Krew

meets.where: Rotates between Sri Hartamas, Bukit Damansara and TTDI

meets.when: Early-morning runs on Tuesdays and Fridays, 4:45am
Weekend long runs and trail runs, announced on Instagram (@kyserunkrew)

clubs.who: Three pace groups: Felix (7:00 min/km and slower), Panther (5:30 to 6:30 min/km) and Tiger Wolf (under 5:30 min/km)
clubs.description: A large KL social run crew; its Strava club has more than 3,000 members. Star Publications reports evening and pre-dawn sessions at rotating spots, weekend long and trail runs, and special runs at KLCC Park.

clubs.name: Mont Kiara Running Club (MKRC)

meets.when: Wednesday and Thursday evenings and Sunday mornings, with smaller runs on other days
meets.where: Mont Kiara and Sri Hartamas roads, and the Bukit Kiara trails

clubs.who: From casual runners to ultra, trail and Ironman athletes
clubs.description: A Mont Kiara club that runs on road and trail, for training, racing and social runs. Members organise through a Facebook group linked from its Strava club.

clubs.name: Hash House Harriers Kuala Lumpur (Mother Hash)

meets.where: Rotating trail sites, usually about an hour's drive from central KL; directions posted on the website

clubs.cost: Guest fee RM50 (RM80 for gazetted runs)
clubs.description: The original hash chapter, founded in Kuala Lumpur in 1938. Runs are mostly on and off trail and finish after dark, so bring trail shoes and a head torch.
clubs.active_evidence: Past run #4279 on 26 Oct 2026 (Broga); hareline lists #4280 on 2 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Petaling Hash House Harriers (PH3)

meets.where: Rotating run sites around the Klang Valley; directions posted on the website

clubs.description: A hash chapter based in Petaling Jaya that has run every Saturday afternoon since 1977, with a social meal after each run.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists run #2509 on 7 Nov 2026 (Puncak Alam) and #2510 on 14 Nov 2026

clubs.name: KL Junior Hash House Harriers

meets.when: Monthly, usually the first Sunday, about 2pm (registration from about 1:20pm)
meets.where: Rotating run sites outside KL; directions posted on the website

clubs.who: Families with children of any age; Malaysians and expats
clubs.description: A family hash that has run monthly since 1982, with long and short trails so children can take part.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists run #531 on 1 Nov 2026 (Batang Kali) and #532 on 6 Dec 2026

clubs.name: Kuala Lumpur Hash House Harriettes (KL Harriettes)

meets.where: Rotating run sites around the Klang Valley; posted on the website

clubs.cost: Guest fee RM40 (RM10 for under-18s); higher at special runs
clubs.who: Mixed; membership is open to everyone, and new members join after running once as a guest
clubs.description: Started in June 1974 as KL's women's hash, it now runs every Wednesday evening as a mixed hash. Bring trail shoes and a torch.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists run #2676 on 4 Nov 2026 (Bandar Baru Selayang) and runs to 18 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Batu Hash

meets.where: Rotating run sites around the Klang Valley; posted on the website

clubs.description: A mixed, non-competitive hash that has run on Wednesday evenings since 13 December 1989, on hills, estates and back roads around the Klang Valley. Bring a torch and your own utensils.
clubs.active_evidence: Website lists run #1830 on 4 Nov 2026 (Gasing Hill)

clubs.name: KL Full Moon Hash

meets.when: Monthly, on a Sunday near the full moon, 4:30pm
meets.where: Rotating run sites around the Klang Valley, such as Rawang and Gombak; posted on the hareline

clubs.who: Mixed; membership is open to everyone
clubs.description: A mixed hash founded in 1992 that first ran on full-moon days and now runs on the nearest Sunday. It has held a yearly joint run with Songkhla Hash in Thailand since 2000.
clubs.active_evidence: Past runs #410 on 27 Sep 2026 and #411 on 25 Oct 2026; #412 listed for 22 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Pacemakers Malaysia

meets.where: Quill City Mall

clubs.who: All levels: slow, medium and fast groups over 8 to 15 km, led by volunteer pacers
clubs.description: One of the biggest community running groups in Kuala Lumpur. Its Saturday Friendship Run draws 300 to 400 runners to Quill City Mall, split into pace groups with about 40 volunteer pacers. The club also holds Thursday evening interval sessions and puts on its own Pacemakers Anniversary Run.
clubs.active_evidence: ToughASIA feature, 23 Mar 2026; Strava interval session, 16 Jul 2026; Pacemakers Anniversary Run, 31 May 2026; club confirmed by email, 8 Oct 2026; PAR2027 (28 Feb 2027) announced on Instagram, 22 Oct 2026

coaches.name: SACRun.Coach (Smart Athletic Coaching)
coaches.offers: Online structured training plans, a weekly group run class on Sundays (6:30am to 8am), online consultations, and two-hour running-technique workshops
coaches.where: Workshops at Arena Sukan, Kuala Lumpur; group class at a selected location
coaches.description: A KL running-coaching company whose training principles date from 2012. Its head coach, Edan Syah, runs the technique and breathing workshops.
coaches.active_evidence: Workshops scheduled for 23 Aug 2026 and 13 Sep 2026, with another in Oct 2026
